integrity: The defining inequality is simplified before any special-function representation is introduced. The proof reconstructs the line-segment univalence estimate from the bounded-harmonic Schwarz bound and the published coefficient estimate, sums the resulting positive series exactly, and proves positivity of the covering radius by an integral identity. The asymptotics follow from the explicit Taylor series and do not rely on numerical fitting.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a guaranteed diagonal Landau and covering estimate, not an optimality theorem. It treats the positive diagonal gamma=delta and excludes the degenerate point gamma=delta=0. The large-M expansion is for the fixed diagonal class and does not analyze simultaneous off-diagonal parameter limits.
title: Diagonal Landau geometry for the generalized harmonic class
